items.title: Akiyoshi Toshiko — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Interviewer: Dr. Anthony Brown with recording engineer Ken Kimery

ctx.x: Interviewee: Toshiko Akiyoshi 穐吉敏子 (December 12, 1929 - )
Interviewer: Dr. Anthony Brown with recording engineer Ken Kimery Description: Transcript 97 pp.
Today is June 29th, 2008, and this is the oral history interview conducted with Toshiko Akiyoshi in her house on 38 W. 94th Street in Manhattan, New York. Good afternoon, Toshiko-san!
